en: Years of resistance to misfortune ended when the settlers' village was overcome by the savages and their hopes and lives came to the bitter end.
cn: 当移居者的村庄被野蛮人征服后，他们的希望和生活到了痛苦的尽头，数年对灾祸的抵抗结束了。

en: The people crowded round the injured man, but they made way for the doctor when he reached the scene of the accident.
cn: 人群把伤者团团围住，但医生来到现场时都让了路给他。

en: This robot does whatever I say. That's a big help when I'm too tired to do anything. Not too likely, huh?
cn: 我叫这个机器人做甚么，它就做甚么。我累得不想动的时候，它就很帮得上忙。- 这种事不太可能吧？

en: But above all, I will never forget who this victory truly belongs to. It belongs to you. It belongs to you.
cn: 但最重要的是，我永远不会忘记这场胜利真正属于谁，它属于你们，它属于你们。

en: A man touched down on the moon. A wall came down in Berlin. A world was connected by our own science and imagination.
cn: 人类登上月球、柏林墙倒下，世界被我们的科学和想像被连接在一起。

en: I am very sorry that I have to ask you to change the meeting date to March 6 due to personal reasons.
cn: 真的很对不起，因为一些私人的理由，我想请你把见面日期改为三月六日。

en: However, it seems that just because it's a 'low risk day' doesn't mean that you won't get pregnant from intravaginal ejaculation.
cn: 但是，虽说是安全期，但好像也不代表体内射精不会怀孕。

en: From childhood I was fond of reading, and all the little money that ever came into my hands was laid out in books.
cn: 从小开始我就很喜欢读书，那时有的钱虽然不多，但也都全花在书本上。

en: On the one hand I called you to invite you to dinner, on the other to tell you my son is getting married.
cn: 我打电话给你，一方面是想请你吃饭，另一方面是想告诉你我儿子要结婚了。

en: If I could be reborn, I would want to be the child of a rich family, then I'd be set for life.
cn: 如果可以投胎转世的话，我想做有钱人家的儿子，一辈子衣食无忧。

en: In my opinion this kind of work is both uninteresting and difficult, but I don't have any other way to earn money.
cn: 我认为这种工作既不有趣又困难, 可是我没有别的方法赚钱。

en: Our teacher also said that her wedding wouldn't be the same as other people's; we asked how it would be different, but she didn't say.
cn: 老师又说，她的婚礼跟别人不一样，我们问怎幺不一样，老师不说。

en: They not only washed off the sweat, dirt and cares of the day in the hot water, but also enjoyed gossiping about everyday affairs.
cn: 他们不只是洗去汗水、污垢和镇日的操劳，同时也沉浸在闲话家常日常生活当中。

en: People are most angry when they feel they are being mocked. That's why those who are confident in themselves seldom become angry.
cn: 人们在备感嘲讽时最生气。这也是为何对自己感到自信的人们不容易生气。

en: Those fated to meet will do so regardless of distance. Those not fated will not, even if they are across from one another.
cn: 有缘千里来相会，无缘对面不相逢。

en: This time, when he went into the hospital, he finally understood that one's health is really the most important thing of all.
cn: 这次一进医院，才知道身体健康最最重要。

en: Next week I have things to do except on Monday and Wednesday, I am free on all the other days though.
cn: 下个礼拜除了星期一星期三有事，我其他日子都有空在那儿。

en: I don't have to go to work today and tomorrow, so I will use the opportunity to quickly finish moving it.
cn: 因为今天明天我休息，所以趁机会快点搬好它。

en: Because families in Shanghai today have only one son or daughter, the head of the family places a strong emphasis on their child's studying.
cn: 因为现在上海家家都是独生子女，家长对小孩的读书非常重视。

en: If you are going to the library this afternoon, would you please return two books for me whilst you are there?
cn: 你今天下午去图书馆的话，可以顺道替我还两本书吗？

en: Mathematics is the part of science you could continue to do if you woke up tomorrow and discovered the universe was gone.
cn: 就算你明天起床，发现整个宇宙消失了，还有一门科学是可以继续研究的 ﹣ 那就是数学了。

en: Friendly Reminder: Please keep in mind the closing time of the line you need to switch to, so as to avoid delays in your trip.
cn: 友情提示：请留意您需要换乘线路的首末班时间，以免耽误您的出行。

en: The next morning, Dima got out of the dumpster, but only to realize that all of his clothes now smelled like garbage.
cn: 第二天早上，狄马从垃圾箱里走了出来，但却发现自己全身的衣服都沾上了垃圾的臭味。

en: Who are the idiots who said that teachers should push for larger amounts of homework, seeing as the students don't work enough?
cn: 说因为学生不够努力，老师应该布置更多回家作业的傻瓜是谁？

en: Using Esperanto with him, I sense that we both are at the same level, at least from a linguistic point of view.
cn: 我和他用世界语沟通，觉得最少从语言的观点来看，我和他的程度是差不多的。

en: Why didn't the half-cooked steak say hello to the nearly-cooked steak when the two saw each other? They both weren't ready.
cn: 五成熟牛排见了七成熟牛排为什幺不打招呼？两个都不熟。

en: The twelve stars on the flag of the European Union do not symbolize the twelve founding members of the union. They symbolize the Twelve Apostles.
cn: 欧盟盟旗的十二颗星代表的不是创立联盟的十二个会员国，而是十二门徒。

en: It had the head of a woman, the body of a lion, the wings of a bird, and the tail of a serpent.
cn: 它长着女人的头、狮子的身体、一双羽翅以及蛇尾巴。

en: Do not fear the heavens and the earth, but be afraid of hearing a person from Wenzhou speak in their local tongue.
cn: 天不怕，地不怕，就怕温州人说温州话。

en: Jane is fat and rude, and smokes too much. However, Ken thinks she's lovely and charming. That's why they say love is blind.
cn: Jane 又胖、又没礼貌、又烟不离手，可是 Ken 却觉得她可爱、动人，所谓「爱情是盲目的」，大概就是这个意思了吧。

en: These days many young people work without much focus; my friend's son hadn't gone two years after graduating before he'd changed jobs five times.
cn: 现在许多年轻人工作都不太安分，朋友的儿子大学毕业不到两年，已经换了五个工作了。

en: In other aspects, the results of Laowang's health examination were all quite normal; it was just that his blood pressure was a bit high.
cn: 老王身体检查的结果别的方面都挺正常，就是血压有点高。

en: It is a term used to describe the warming of the earth due to increasing amounts of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere.
cn: 这个词指的是由于大气层里二氧化碳含量增多而导致全球变暖。

en: The feelings of "love at first sight" and "faithful unto death" are unrealistic; this sort of unrealistic and illusory feeling is not what we need.
cn: 「一见钟情」以及「从一而终」的感情是不切实际的，我们需要的不是这种不切实际而虚幻的感情。

en: The most important thing about relations with the opposite sex is not how good the other person is, but that they treat you well.
cn: 跟异性交往最重要的不是他有多好,而是他对你有多好。

en: Every guy can say: "Although I'm not the greatest man in the world, I am the man who is best to you."
cn: 每一个男孩子都可 以说:『虽然我不是世界上最好的男人,但我是世界对妳最好的男人』。

en: The most important thing in a relationship lies in how good your partner is to you, and not in how good they are themselves.
cn: 感情最重要的是在于他对你的好，而不是他自己有多好。

en: Carbon dioxide is a gas that is produced every time a fuel such as coal, oil, or natural gas is burned.
cn: 二氧化碳是燃烧煤、石油或天然气这样的燃料时会产生的气体。

en: The modern version, which is now popularly recognized in China as the standard qipao, was first developed in Shanghai after 1900.
cn: 现在中国公认的标准旗袍的现代版本是首先在上海发展起来的。

en: By the 1940s, the qipao came in a wide variety of designs and fabrics, with an equally wide variety of accessories.
cn: 到了四十年代，旗袍有了种类繁多的图案和面料，也有了同样种类繁多的饰品。

en: He put up a brave and lone struggle, but up against such heavy odds he couldn't get his business plan accepted.
cn: 他提出了一个勇敢而孤独的斗争，但这些沉重的打击，他的赔率不能得到他的商业计划接受。

en: As long as you have someone you love from the heart, you have a motivating force and you can face the entire world.
cn: 只要你有一个心爱的人,你就有了原动力,你就能面对全世界。

en: I had words with the manager of that store, because he refused to refund my money for the TV set that wasn't operating properly.
cn: 我找商店经理谈了话，因为他拒绝为那不能用的电视退钱。

en: The giant panda is recognised as a national treasure of China, but in some conservation areas it is still killed by poachers.
cn: 大熊猫被认为是中国的国宝，但在一些保护区，它仍被偷猎。

en: If we don't make the utmost effort to protect the rainforests, many of the rare species in them will become extinct.
cn: 如果我们不做更多的努力去保护雨林，很多其中的稀有物种将会灭绝。

en: The Chinese government has spent a lot of money on research into successful panda breeding in order to increase their birth rate.
cn: 为了提高出生率，中国政府花了很多钱在大熊猫成功繁殖的研究上。

en: Leave the bike here, and tomorrow bring your ID and 20 dollars to the Bureau of Communications to get the bike back.
cn: 你们把自行车留下，明天带着身份证和20块钱到交通局领自行车。

en: In ancient China there were no cats; the cat that we are familiar with today was not imported into China from abroad until much later.
cn: 中国古代没有猫，现在我们所熟悉的猫其实是很晚才由国外传入中国的。

en: If you pay attention to your foreign friends, you may be surprised that their customs and habits are different from yours.
cn: 要是你注意你的外国朋友，可能会对他们跟你不一样的传统和习惯而感到惊讶。

en: This house is nearby, it has two bedrooms and a living room, and the decoration isn't bad; it's 1500 a month.
cn: 这房子在附近，两室一厅，装修也不错，一个月1500。

en: One hutong connects with another, siheyuans connect with other siheyuans to form a block, and blocks join with other blocks to form the whole city.
cn: 一个胡同连接另一个，四合院和其他四合院形成一个街区，而街区跟其他街区汇集成一个城市。

en: The large siheyuans of these high-ranking officials and wealthy merchants often featured beautifully carved and painted roof beams and pillars and carefully landscaped gardens.
cn: 这些高官和富商的大四合院常常有精美雕刻并粉刷的横梁和柱子，并伴有精心修剪的花园。

en: Nearly all siheyuans had their main buildings and gates facing south for better lighting, so a majority of hutongs run from east to west.
cn: 因为几乎所有的四合院有南面的门和主要楼房，所以大部分的胡同是从东到西建造的。

en: Since the mid-20th century, the number of hutongs in Beijing has dropped dramatically as they are demolished to make way for new roads and buildings.
cn: 二十世纪中以后，北京胡同的数量显着地下降，因为人们把它们拆毁以便给新的楼房和街路让路。

en: More recently, some hutongs have been designated as protected areas in an attempt to preserve this aspect of Chinese cultural history.
cn: 最近，有些胡同被指定为保护区，以试图保存这方面的中国文化历史。

en: Last time I went to a Lady Gaga concert, although she finished all her songs, many members of the audience were not satisfied.
cn: 上次去看雷帝嘎嘎的演唱会， 尽管她唱完歌了，很多听歌的人却不满足。

en: Although the pressure of studying at the University of Cambridge is very high, many students still have time to go out and have fun.
cn: 尽管在剑桥学习压力很大，很多学生还是有时间出去玩儿。

en: Normally speaking, Chinese people consider rice to be an important food; the majority of Westerners consider fast food to be an important food.
cn: 一般而言，中国人将米饭视为重要的食物；而大部分的西方人则将速食视为重要的食物。

en: The first day of the first month in the Chinese lunar calendar is Spring Festival, the most important festival for the people of China.
cn: 中国农历年的一月一日为春节，是中国人民最隆重的传统节日。

en: If you mention New Year in China, the image that many people will think of is a family gathered around wrapping dumplings together.
cn: 在中国，提到过年，许多人想到的都是一家围在一起包饺子。

en: Especially in northern China, wrapping and eating dumplings has become an important activity for happily spending New Year's Eve in many households.
cn: 尤其是在中国北方，包饺子、吃饺子，已经成为大多数家庭欢度除夕的一个重要活动。

en: It exists, but seeing as it is taboo and that nobody talks about it, there's no need to have words for it.
cn: 它的确存在, 但是因为人们将它视为禁忌而不去谈论它, 也就不需要多说什么了。

en: Fifteen per cent of the housing will be affordable, so that low-income families will be able to buy or rent homes in the area.
cn: 百分之十五的房屋将是经济适用，所以低收入家庭会在这个地区买或者租房子。

en: It is estimated that only a few hundred pandas remain, with a small number of them being raised in zoos in China and abroad.
cn: 据估计只有几百只遗留的熊猫，其中的少数圈养在中国和国外的动物园。

en: Why am I the only one they complain about? They're just making an example out of me and using me as a scapegoat.
cn: 为什么我是他们唯一抱怨的人? 他们就这样拿我作例子, 利用我当代罪羔羊。

en: The Romans would never have had the chance to conquer the world if they had first been required to study Latin.
cn: 如果他们必须先学拉丁文的话，是没有机会让罗马人征服世界的对吧。

en: When booking flights, I decided the easiest way would be to fly to Beijing first, then get the train to complete my journey.
cn: 预定机票时我决定最容易的办法就是先坐飞机到北京，然后坐火车完成我的旅程。

en: At the train station, once I had figured out where the queue for tickets actually was, I began the long wait.
cn: 在车站，我把排队买票的地点弄清楚后，开始久等。

en: Without warning, the teachers ask students from each country to take the microphone and explain to everyone their reasons for coming to Harbin.
cn: 冷不防，老师让每个国家的学生用话筒给大家讲一下自己来哈尔滨的原因。

en: If you think that I'm still going to help a bastard like you, then you couldn't be any further away from the truth.
cn: 如果你认为我还会帮你这样的混蛋，那你大错特错了。

en: In the sphere of thought, absurdity and perversity remain the masters of the world, and their dominion is suspended only for brief periods.
cn: 在思想的领域中, 荒诞和堕落仍然主宰着世界, 它们的操控只是短时间地被暂停。

en: Each of us is like the moon: there is a dark side of us that we do not let others see.
cn: 我们每个人就像是月亮: 我们从来没有让别人看到我们黑暗的一面。

en: Just one part of what he said got picked up by the media and took on a life of its own.
cn: 媒体对他所说的话断章取义并发展到无法控制的地步了。

en: To better understand what a company’s culture is you should consider the following points and see how the company deals with them.
cn: 为了更好地理解一家公司的文化，你应该考虑下面的论点，并看公司把它们怎幺处理。

en: Translation is like a woman. If it is beautiful, it is not faithful. If it is faithful, it is most certainly not beautiful.
cn: 翻译就像一个女人。她漂亮就会不忠诚；她忠诚就肯定不会漂亮。

en: I lost a school key when I was cleaning up after the school festival and I was then required to write an apology letter.
cn: 我在校庆后打扫的时候弄掉了一把学校的钥匙，我被迫写了一份检讨。

en: If you find a bad wife and get married to her, then it will certainly be difficult to be happy later.
cn: 如果你找到一个坏妻子并和她结婚, 那么以后一定会很难过得快乐。

en: The man on whom you see the Spirit come down and remain is he who will baptize with the Holy Spirit.
cn: 你如果看见圣灵降下，落在谁身上，谁就是用圣灵替人施洗的了。

en: The Romans would never have had enough time for conquering the world if they had first been required to study Latin.
cn: 如果他们必须先学拉丁文的话，是没有时间让罗马人征服世界的对吧。

en: My impression of this government is that they need a more forceful economic policy, otherwise they'll encounter large problems in the future.
cn: 我对这个政府的印象是，他们需要强一点儿的经济政策，要不然将来会遇到很大的问题。

en: So I thought my date, er rather, offline-meeting was going to be just me and her but things aren't that easy.
cn: 所以之前我认为我的约会，或者更确切的说，下线后的网聚将只有我和她，但是事情并非那么简单。

en: FSI officer: "Sir, there is a website where ANYONE can add a sentence in a foreign language!". FSI president: "What?! Bomb them!".
cn: FSI人员:"长官，有一个网站，任何人都可以加上一个外国语言的句子!"。FSI主席:"什么? 炸掉他们!"。

en: In Tatoeba, you gotta always listen to veteran members. They'll tell you what can't be done and why. Then do it.
cn: 在Tatoeba，你必须总是倾听资深成员。他们会告诉你什么不能做，以及为什么。然后你去做。

en: You cannot compare the strength of a man to that of a tiger, but nevertheless, the tiger is still the inferior creature.
cn: 虎与人是无法比拼力量的，但是，老虎还是比人类低等。

en: The second half of a man's life is made up of nothing but the habits he has acquired during the first half.
cn: 人的后半生就是由他前半生养成的习惯所构成的，其他什幺都没有。

en: When I was a teenager I had lots of hair on my head and none on my chest. Now it's just the opposite.
cn: 当我还是年轻人的时候，我脑袋上有很多头发，胸上无毛。现在，恰恰相反。

en: The reason the Northern and Southern Dynasties had failed in their rule was that they allowed literary splendor to surpass real substance.
cn: 南北朝在他们的统治之下失败了的原因是他们让文学的光辉超越了实质内容。

en: I don't have a stamp collection, but I have a Japanese postcard collection that I could use as an excuse to invite him.
cn: 我没有集邮，但是却收藏了一堆日本的明信片，我想我可以用这来做借口，邀请他来我家。

en: Women really are quite dangerous. The more I think about this, the more I'm able to understand the reasoning behind face covering.
cn: 女人真是太危险了。越想这一点越能理解蒙脸的道理。

en: Idiot! She's not being honest when she says she loves you. Haven't you figured it out yet? She's just a gold digger.
cn: 笨蛋！她说她爱你不是真心的。还没有发现吗？她只是钓凯子的。

en: I prefer traditional characters. Due to the abundance of reading materials in simplified characters, I can recognize many of them too.
cn: 我偏爱繁体字。因为有大量的简体字的阅读材料，我也认识很多简体字。

en: And even outside these nations, English is perhaps more widely used as a medium of international communication than any other language.
cn: 甚至在这些国家以外，英语也许比其他任何语言更广泛地被使用来当作国际交流的媒介。

en: Is it OK for me to remove my wedding ring and go to a dating party when I have a pregnant wife?
cn: 当我有一个怀孕的妻子，而我取下我的结婚戒指去约会派对是可行的事吗？

en: When answering this question, some people might put forward this kind of example: "Chinese people are very hospitable, whilst English people are more reserved."
cn: 回答这个问题时，有的人可能提出“中国人很好客而英国人比较矜持的”这样的例子。

en: There are many people in the world studying English, so English people are used to learners' non-standard accents, their grammatical errors and so on.
cn: 世界上学习英语的人很多，所以英国人习惯学习者的不标准的口音、语法错误等等。

en: All that time the things granddad had said, like the sound of flies flying round a melon, buzzed in my head.
cn: 一直以来爷爷曾经说过的事，像苍蝇绕着瓜飞的声音，在我的脑海里嗡嗡地响着。

en: He taught contemplation as a means of spiritual purification and the attainment of the Dao, a principle that signifies the highest spiritual ideals of mankind.
cn: 他为精神的洁净和获得道的方法教深思，道是表示人类最高的精神理想的一个原则。

en: His teachings are incorporated in a profound book Daode Jing which Taoists regard as the final authority and doctrines of the religion.
cn: 他的教导都包含在道教者看作关于宗教最后的权威的道德经那本深刻的书。

en: It is generally believed that Buddhism first came to China in 67 A.D. during the reign of Emperor Mingdi of the Eastern Han Dynasty.
cn: 普遍认为佛教公元六七年在东汉明帝的统治时先来中国。

en: It's obvious that I spend too much time studying Chinese characters, so I ought to study other aspects of the language more.
cn: 可想而知我在学汉字上花太多时间，所以我应该更好地练习语言的其他方面。

en: As for physical exercise, although I loathe most sports (I think they're really boring), I do like going to the gym to lift weights.
cn: 要说锻炼身体，虽然我痛恨大部分的运动，觉得它们真的无聊，但是我喜欢去健身房举重。

en: When you're about to have exams, lifting weights really does relieve stress, and it's also good for your mind and body.
cn: 快要考试的时候，举重真的消愁解闷，再说对身体和精神都很好。

en: When I put 100 yen in and pressed the button to buy a coffee at the vending machine, four cans dropped down all at once!
cn: 当我把100日元放进自动贩卖机并按下按钮要买一罐咖啡的时候，突然间四罐咖啡掉了下来！

en: Firstly, I think that the first time each foreigner is in China, the earliest impression is certainly the size of the country.
cn: 首先，我认为每个外国人第一次在中国的时候，最初的印象一定是国家的大小。

en: For example, China's public transport is without a doubt better than the UK's, but the UK's public welfare may be better than China's.
cn: 例如，中国的公共交通毫不怀疑比英国的好，但英国的公益事业可能比中国的好。

en: If you have no way to buy food, clothing, accommodation and other such daily necessities, you definitely won't be able to have peace of mind.
cn: 如果你没办法买饭、衣服、住处这种日常需要等，你并不会得安心。

en: Gambling site lets users bet on which species will go extinct because of the oil spill in the Gulf of Mexico.
cn: 赌博网站让用户投注在将灭绝的物种上，因为墨西哥湾漏油。

en: On May 18, a young Japanese couple was arrested after their one-year-old baby was found wrapped in a plastic bag and dumped in a gutter.
cn: 一对年轻日本夫妇，把一岁大的亲生婴儿放进胶袋，弃置于排水沟中，于五月十八日被捕。

en: The art of modern warfare does not necessarily require soldiers to be armed to the teeth to be effective as combatants.
cn: 现代战术并无指明士兵必须全副武装上阵才能发挥其最大的战斗力。

en: Please notify me by e-mail about any bugs found or missing functions that you want to be included in future versions of the BMI calculator.
cn: 发现任何错误或在BMI计算器以后的版本中希望加入的缺失功能，请用邮件通知我。

en: I’ve heard the example of the parents in Korea who let their child die because they were too busy playing video games.
cn: 我听过在韩国的父母因为忙于玩游戏而让他们的孩子死了的那个例子。

en: For several years I've been in the habit of, when I'm at home, only leaving my desk when it's time to eat.
cn: 这是我数年的习惯了，在家里除了吃饭以外我很少离开我的桌子。

en: In the end, because of the disease, he became unable to walk and had to use a motorized wheelchair to get around.
cn: 最后，他的病夺去了他走路的能力，想去哪儿也要用电动轮椅来代步。

en: As soon as we are born, the world gets to work on us and transforms us from merely biological into social units.
cn: 我们一出生在这个世界上，就会开始受到周遭环境的影响，从生物单位慢慢进化成社会单位。

en: This function takes two parameters, the first one is the title of the window, the second one will be the title of the icon.
cn: 这个函数有两个参数，第一个是窗体的标题，另一个是图标的标题。

en: I heard the manager's wife is on vacation. And, well, when the cat's away, the mice play. Now he's out partying every night.
cn: 我听说经理的妻子出去度假了。这时就是山中无老虎，猴子称大王了。现在经理他夜夜笙箫。

en: Why did you wake me up to tell me something that big? Now, I'll never be able to concentrate on my work!
cn: 你为什幺要唤我起来，告诉我如此晴天霹雳的消息? 现在你教我如何认真工作?

en: He and I have a near-telepathic understanding of each other. No sooner does one of us say something than the other is already responding.
cn: 他和我简直心有灵犀，才刚说一句，另一方已经回应。

en: Of course you'll catch a cold if you fall asleep under the kotatsu. You have to learn to take care of yourself.
cn: 如果你睡在kotatsu下当然会感冒。你要学会照顾好自己。

en: Magnanimity is a great treasure; harmonious affinity with others is wonderful, Detachment from name and gain averts trouble; happiness makes older people feel young.
cn: 宽宏大量是个宝; 与人无争结缘好 放下名利不烦恼; 心生欢喜不觉老.

en: To be in love is not the same as loving. You can be in love with a woman and still hate her.
cn: 被爱和爱一个人不同。你可以被一个人爱着的同时，却恨着这个人。

en: Do not think that love, in order to be genuine, has to be extraordinary. What we need is to love without getting tired.
cn: 不要觉得真诚的爱必需惊天动地。我们需要的，是不会倦怠的爱。

en: If you ask her too directly whether she has a friend, she will become suspicious and answer: "Why did you ask me that?"
cn: 如果你太直接问她有没有朋友，她会怀疑且反问：“你为什幺要这样问？”

en: He puts on a show of being impartial and unbiased, but I think he's just a guy with no opinion of his own.
cn: 他总在别人面前装出大公无私的样子，但依我看，他只不过是个没有主见的家伙。

en: Why does the phone have to ring all the time only when I'm busy? I can't get any work done because of it.
cn: 为什幺电话老在我忙的时候响？我都没法干活了。

en: On the client side, very time-consuming operations should run asynchronously so as to avoid freezing the browser. The best example is the operation of Ajax.
cn: 在浏览器端，耗时很长的操作都应该异步执行，避免浏览器失去响应，最好的例子就是 Ajax 操作。

en: You yourself belong to this group of people that you're talking about - the one that doesn't speak standard Mandarin well.
cn: 你说普通话不好的包括你自己。

en: It's a lot of trouble to write my name, because it takes 50 strokes to write both my first and last names.
cn: 我的姓、名一共有五十划，写起来麻烦得很。

en: If you used the time you spent complaining practicing your basketball, then maybe you would have stopped complaining a long time ago.
cn: 如果你把你抱怨的时间用在练习篮球上，你或许早已不必抱怨。

en: If you have a bone to pick with a person, tell it to his face instead of saying things behind his back.
cn: 如果你们之间有问题，应该当面告诉他，不要在背后说他。

en: We exchanged pleasantries, and chatted cordially about news in the team, and he moved the conversation naturally on to the main topic.
cn: 我们照例寒暄了一阵，闲扯扯队里的新闻以后，他在不知不觉中就把谈话引入了正题。

en: If you're going to say it, you have to say it with force, and take away your opponent's ability to retaliate.
cn: 要说，就要说得有力量，使对方失去反驳的能力。

en: Be mindful of your actions when in a relationship.What may seem playful to you could really be harmful to your partner.
cn: 请小心地呵护两人之间的感情。也许当你认为只是一个玩笑时，却真真切切地伤了对方的心。

en: If a piece of knotted string can unleash the wind, and if a drowned man can awaken, then I believe a broken man can heal.
cn: 如果一段打结的绳子能换来风，如果淹死的人能再醒来，那幺我相信伤了心的人会痊愈。

en: I put roll-on antiperspirant all over my body. If sweat starts squirting out the top of my head, you know why.
cn: 我把整个止汗剂抹遍全身。如果汗从我脑顶喷出来，你就知道原因了。

en: Thinking to get at once all the gold the goose could give, he killed it and opened it only to find - nothing.
cn: 他满脑子想的都是立刻得到鹅体内的金蛋，所以他杀了鹅，然后他发现鹅身体里没有任何东西。

en: Even now, I occasionally think I'd like to see you. Not the you that you are today, but the you I remember from the past.
cn: 即使是现在，我偶尔还是想见到你。不是今天的你，而是我记忆中曾经的你。

en: If you have not paid because you are displeased with something we have done, would you tell us what it is?
cn: 如果您还没付钱是因为我们做了什么让您不高兴的事，可以请您告诉我们吗?

en: The moon has no light of its own, but rather it reflects the light of the sun to the children of the night.
cn: 月本无光，借光于日，返照夜之游子。

en: The QA team has discovered a serious bug. As a consequence, it is recommended that all work be reviewed from the beginning.
cn: QA团队发现了一个重大bug，因此，建议重新审查所有工作。

en: The fundamental cause of the problem is that in the modern world, idiots are full of confidence, while the intelligent are full of doubt.
cn: 问题的根源是，在当今世界，愚人充满了自信，而智者充满了怀疑。

en: Yesterday a friend of mine that I hadn't seen in years gave me a call out of the blue asking to borrow money.
cn: 昨天一个很多年没联系的朋友突然打电话给我，问我借钱。

en: On the one hand we suffered a heavy loss, but on the other hand we learned a great deal from the experience.
cn: 一方面我们虽然蒙受了损失，但另一方面我们从这次经验中学到了很多。

en: Make sure you get rid of your cold. You've got to be ready again next week. We can't do without you.
cn: 你的伤风要快点好啊，下个礼拜你就又要准备好了啦，我们没了你是不行的。

en: When Mike tried to tackle the other player, he pushed him and he was given a yellow card and a warning.
cn: 当迈克试图铲球的时候，他用手推了对方球员一把，结果得到了黄牌警告。

en: I think that Brazil has the strongest football team in the world and they have a good chance of winning the 2014 World Cup.
cn: 我认为，巴西拥有世界上最强大的足球队，他们很有可能在2014年世界杯中获胜。

en: Tom's daughter pretended not to know him when he came to pick her up from school in his battered old car.
cn: 当汤姆开着他破旧的雷泽车来接女儿放学时，他的女儿假装不认识他。

en: I want people to appreciate the beauty of my native language, and I want to experience how beautiful other languages can be, too.
cn: 我想要人们欣赏我的母语的优美，并且我也想要感受其他语言的美妙。

en: Shh! Don't make a sound. We are playing hide-and-seek now. If you want to talk, go find somewhere else to hide.
cn: Shh！不要出声……我们现在捉迷藏，要搞的话快点找一个地方躲藏一边了。

en: As the saying goes: "good always triumphs over evil". But there's another saying that: "the fight against evil is a constant struggle".
cn: 俗话说：邪不压正；可俗话又说：道高一尺，魔高一丈！

en: The vast majority of Chinese people have never met foreigners before, so it feels odd for them, like meeting space aliens.
cn: 大多数中国人没见过几个外国人，觉得特新奇，看见外星人的感觉。

en: The school won't turn on the air conditioning, so the students are going to throw their hot water flasks off of the balcony in protest.
cn: 学校不给开空调，学生们就会从阳台上扔热水瓶抗议。

en: It doesn't matter whether your beard has grown for four years or seven. When the barber shaves it he'll use that same blade.
cn: 不论你的胡子长了四年还是七年, 理发师用刀子剔的时间都是一样的。

en: There is a proverb that goes "time is money", but there is another one that goes "money can't buy you time".
cn: 俗话说：一寸光阴一寸金；可俗话又说：寸金难买寸光阴！

en: The most enlightened way of living is to despise social conventions while at the same time living your life in conformity to them.
cn: 最光明的处世方法是既蔑视社会的因袭，又过着与社会的因袭不相矛盾的生活。

en: I admit that if it weren't for him, the next ten years of my life would have been empty and devoid of purpose.
cn: 我承认，没有他，我未来十年的生活将会是空虚的、没有目标的。

en: The repairs cost a lot more than 15 dollars, of course, but I am grateful to them for finding a solution.
cn: 理所当然，修理费用比15元还要多更多，但是我非常感激他们找到了解决的办法。

en: Well... the teacher said that we have to go into a group of 3-5 people, so this isn't going to work.
cn: 嗯。。。老师说我们必须加入一个3-5人的小组，所以我们没办法开始工作

en: We'll be going outside to observe nature for this. Thus, a good pencil, eraser, and possibly a paint brush are required.
cn: 我们将要到室外去观察大自然。因此，一支好的笔，橡皮和大概一支画笔是必需的。

en: There is absolutely no reason that you should even attempt to speak with the Chinese girls, or at least these ones. They're so rude!
cn: 你完全没有理由去试图和那些中国女孩子交流，或者至少那些人。他们非常的粗鲁！

en: Even if an intelligent man loves a woman deeply, he will never show his love to her, but merely keep it in his heart.
cn: 聪明的男人就算爱极了一个女人，也只是藏在心里，绝不会将他的爱在她面前表现出来。

en: You should not be rude towards beauties and you should not waste good wine. You must keep these two things in mind in the future.
cn: 佳人不可唐突，好酒不可糟蹋，这两件事你以后一定要牢记在心。

en: I'm sorry, Tom, but seeing how much you've disappointed me, I'm afraid that I am unable to believe in your abilities.
cn: 我很抱歉，Tom，但是看看你的让我失望了多少次，恐怕我没办法再相信你的能力了。

en: According to a study published in 2016, Germany is the best country in the world and Canada is the second best country.
cn: 根据2016年发表的一项研究，德国是世界上最好的国家，加拿大是第二好的国家。

en: It is said that the Japanese are very friendly to those that they know, and very indifferent to those they don't.
cn: 据说日本人对他们认识的人非常友好，对不认识的人非常冷淡。

en: Man is the only animal that can remain on friendly terms with the victims he intends to eat until he eats them.
cn: 人类是在没吃掉对方前能够与对方和睦相处的唯一动物。

en: The difference between a standalone sentence and a sentence in the middle of an essay is that the latter has context.
cn: 独立的句子和文章中的句子的区别在于后者具备上下文。

en: A math teacher says, "With a calculator, the child can reach the right answer, but have no idea at all how he got there."
cn: 有个数学教师说：“有了计算器，孩子可以得出正确结果，但根本不知道怎幺得来的。”

en: A Christian transgendered person I know said: "God has better things to do than to make up rules on who can use which bathroom."
cn: 我认识的一个基督教变性者说：“相比于制定让人用哪个卫生间的规则，上帝有更好的事情去做。”

en: Lake Manicouagan, a ring-shaped lake in Quebec, Canada, is all that remains of a crater from a massive impact over 200 million years ago.
cn: 马尼夸根湖是加拿大魁北克的环形湖，是2亿年前一场巨大冲击形成的陨石坑遗迹。

en: You can't seriously expect that they won't recognize you in that disguise. That lopsided, dime store moustache is a dead giveaway!
cn: 你不能指望他们认不出你的伪装。那个歪半边的一角店胡子是致命漏洞！

en: I have a dull pain in my temples and my mind feels like its covered with a thin layer of fog.
cn: 太阳穴钝钝地痛，意识似乎被笼罩上了一层薄薄的雾霭。

en: He is always popular among his friends. So whenever he comes across troubles or emergencies, they are happy to offer help.
cn: 他的人缘向来很好，因此一旦遭遇急难，朋友都乐意帮忙。

en: Don't fear! This way he certainly won't think that you've brought any contraband, and won't cause a holdup by checking over your luggage.
cn: 不用害怕啦，这样他才不会觉得你带了什么违禁品然后翻箱检查耽误时间。

en: Don't be nervous. Because of this he won't think you're carrying any contraband, and won't open your trunk to check, and hold you up.
cn: 别紧张，如此一来他就不会认为你带了违禁品而开箱检查耽搁时间。

en: I know not with what weapons World War III will be fought, but World War IV will be fought with sticks and stones.
cn: 我不知道第三次世界大战会用哪些武器，但第四次世界大战中人们肯定用的是木棍和石块。

en: But if you're wrong, don't give up. Because you don't know what's going to happen next. Remember, don't give up easily.
cn: 但是，如果你动错了，你别放弃。因为你不知道接下来会发生什么。记得，不要轻易放弃。

en: It is easier for a camel to pass through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God.
cn: 富人要进天国，比骆驼穿过针孔还要难。

en: My way of looking at things is not at all similar to other people's. For a long time, people have criticized my point of view.
cn: 我和别人的看法毫不相同；很久以来，人们就指摘我这一点。

en: Shanghai is so prosperous; notably it was after the port was opened for trade one hundred and sixty years ago that things started to change.
cn: 上海那幺繁荣，主要是一百六十年前开埠以后发生的变化。

en: In Olympic competitions, a gold medal is for first place, a silver medal for second, and a bronze medal is for third place.
cn: 在奥运会的竞赛中，金牌代表第一名，银牌代表第二名，铜牌是第三名。

en: Peter was an altruistic video game player; he would give items to people who needed them, rather than selling them for personal profit.
cn: 彼得是一个利他主义的游戏玩家，他会把东西给需要的人，而不是为一己之私利出售。

en: If there are 1000 steps between us, you only need to take one step, and I will take the other 999 to you.
cn: 如果我们之间有1000步的距离，你只要跨出第1步，我就会朝着你的方向走其余的999步。

en: She drinks alcohol-free beer almost every day, because her favourite drink is beer, but she doesn't want to drink alcohol every day.
cn: 她几乎每天都喝不含酒精的啤酒，因为啤酒是她喜欢的饮料，但是她不想每天都喝酒精。

en: I don't like going out to have fun. Usually, I make my own coffee at home, and have a game of chess with a friend.
cn: 我不喜欢出去玩，常常在家泡壶咖啡，跟朋友下围棋象棋。

en: The mainland of China covers 96,000,000 square kilometers, and it is the largest country in Asia, as well as the third largest in the world.
cn: 中国陆地的总面积是960万平方公里，是亚洲面积最大的国家，居世界第三位。

en: However, there are fewer people learning Chinese, so I think Chinese people are not too familiar with the foreign accents and mistakes.
cn: 但是，学习中文的人比较少，所以我认为有的中国人不太习惯外国人的口音和错误。

en: The Chinese mainland's coasts are surrounded by the Bohai sea, the Yellow Sea, the East China sea and the South China sea.
cn: 中国大陆的沿海有渤海，黄海，东海和南海。

en: Your face looks pale. Are you OK? Maybe it would be better if you went to the hospital, don't you think?
cn: 脸色这幺差不要紧吗？要不还是去一趟医院比较好吧？

en: It's very easy to sound natural in your own native language, and very easy to sound unnatural in your non-native language.
cn: 你很容易把母语说得通顺流畅，却很容易把非母语说得不自然。

en: Government officials say there’s no evidence to support the suggestion that Chinese students may be the ones inadvertently spreading the virus.
cn: 政府官员表示，没有证据支撑中国学生可能是无意中传播病毒的人的观点。

en: I became acquainted with beautiful Polish women at the university in Brazil, and I also met there some very friendly people who could speak Polish.
cn: 我在巴西的大学认识了美丽的波兰女士，也见了一些会说波兰语的友好的人们。

en: Tom wrote propaganda online without pay for the government, but cried when everyone in his hometown was massacred by the government.
cn: 汤姆在网上免费为政府写宣传，但他在他的家乡被政府屠杀时哭了。

en: Now Ghouate's village is connected to the world's largest functioning fog collection project, alleviating the need to collect water that fell mainly on women.
cn: 现在，Ghouate 的村庄与世界上最大的功能雾收集项目相连，减轻了主要落在妇女身上的收集水的需要。

en: I think that Tom is going to be pretty mad when he finds out that the painting he bought is a fake.
cn: 我觉得当汤姆发现他买来的画是赝品的时候，他会很生气。

en: The state will build specially made bridges so that koalas and other wildlife can cross roads while avoiding cars and trucks.
cn: 该州将修建特制的桥梁以便考拉和其他野生动物可以在避开汽车和卡车的情况下过马路。

en: Narcissists are often snobbish, disdainful and patronising of others' opinions, while, at the same time, having an overwhelming need for admiration and reassurance.
cn: 自恋的人往往自命不凡，轻蔑和屈尊俯就于他人的意见，与此同时，对赞美和肯定有着迫切的需求。

en: China, otherwise known as the People's Republic of China, is located in east Asia, on the western coast of the Pacific ocean.
cn: 中国，全名中华人民共和国，位于亚洲东部，太平洋西岸。

en: I got the sack but I've a little saved up, so for the time being I won't be troubled by living expenses.
cn: 虽然我被公司解雇了，但是我还有点存款，所以目前不用担心生计问题。

en: The Party seeks power entirely for its own sake. We are not interested in the good of others; we are interested solely in power.
cn: 党为自己的利益追求势力。我们对别人不体贴；我们只追求势力。

en: When you do not know if someone really loves you as much as you love him, it is very hard to truly love him.
cn: 当你不知道对方是否像你爱着对方一样爱着自己的时候，便很难爱上一个人。

en: The "complete breakfasts" in cereal commercials always include cereal, milk, toast, and orange juice, but even Americans don't usually eat that much in the morning.
cn: 玉米片广告的 “完整早餐” 总有玉米片、牛奶、烤面包和橙汁，但是连美国人的早餐没有那幺丰富。

en: As the saying goes, "You reap what you sow", and yet another says that luck plays an important role in success too!
cn: 俗话说：一分耕耘、一分收获；可俗话又说：人无横财不富、马无夜草不肥！

en: Sorry, but I have to go now. I have an appointment in one hour. Please don't forget to call me back when I get home.
cn: 不好意思，我先走了。我一个小时后有约会。我回家后，请别忘了打回给我。

en: Remember what should be remembered, forget what should be forgotten, change what can be changed, and accept what can't be changed.
cn: 记住该记住的，忘记该忘记的。改变能改变的，接受不能改变的。

en: With the heirless king going crazy and royal family poisoned, the general of the army finally had his chance to usurp the throne.
cn: 随着无继承人的国王的发疯和王室家族的中毒，将军终于有机会篡夺王位。

en: It's about as easy to start a union in a Walmart as it is to start an atheist club in the Vatican.
cn: 在沃尔玛建立工会和在梵蒂冈建立无神论俱乐部一样容易。

en: At first the forensics team thought that they'd discovered human blood, only to find out later, at the lab, that it was bovine.
cn: 一开始法医团队以为他们发现了人血，但后来才在实验室里发现这原来是牛血。

en: But I dare to say that it is better to face those few but powerful interests, rather than eventually facing the fury of society.
cn: 但我敢说解决这些少数群体的利益问题—虽然这些利益很大，但总比以后面对社会的愤怒好。

en: Due to the catastrophe caused by the huge tsunami, damage was sustained by the nuclear reactor as well as explosions at the nuclear power plant.
cn: 由于特大海啸的灾害，核能融炉遭受损害，造成了原子能发电站爆炸。

en: I don't have a washing machine at home, and so I have to go to the washing room in order to do the laundry.
cn: 因为我家没有洗衣机，我必须去洗衣房洗衣服。

en: The depravity of the king's deeds led the people to believe he was nothing more than a tyrant that needed to be overthrown.
cn: 国王的卑劣行为致使人们相信他只是个该被推翻的暴君。

en: Don't mix up the Americas with the United States of America, or citizens of the Americas with citizens of the United States.
cn: 别混淆美洲和美国，美洲人和美国人。

en: There's not a lot of time left until the meeting starts. Let's go inside and have a look at who's there.
cn: 会议很快就开始了，我们进去看看有谁来了。

en: Whether your mother likes it or not, she will sooner or later have to accept the idea that her daughter has grown up.
cn: 无论妳的母亲愿不愿意，她迟早得接受她的女儿已成年这个事实。

en: I knew since middle school that only because I was so lonely was I able to expend so much energy on studying.
cn: 从中学的时候我就知道，我能够花很多功夫去学习仅仅是因为我过得很寂寞。

en: When both girls told John they had feelings for him, he was in a quandary as to which girl he should be with.
cn: 当两个女生都跟约翰宣称她们对他有感觉时，他不知道该跟哪个谈恋爱了。

en: Tom doesn't like to use the term "a person of color" because he thinks it implies that white people have no color.
cn: 汤姆不喜欢使用”有色人种“这个术语，因为他认为，根据这种说法白种人没有颜色。

en: If you don't want to put on sunscreen, that's your problem. Just don't come complaining to me when you get a sunburn.
cn: 你不想涂防晒霜是你的问题，但是晒伤了不要来抱怨。

en: Don't think I've forgotten you already, you've been on my mind, but I haven't been able to take the time to write to you.
cn: 不要以为我已经忘了你，你在我的脑海中，但我抽不出时间给你写信。

en: You see the words that I typed on the screen, but you don't see the tears that I shed over the keyboard.
cn: 你看得见我打在萤幕上的字，却看不到我掉在键盘上的泪。

en: Declaring war after a surprise attack is to be expected, but killing over ten thousand non-combatants with a bomb is something unheard of.
cn: 被突袭后宣告战争是可以预想的，但用炸弹屠杀万人以上的平民却是前所未闻的。

en: Ray was willing to corroborate Gary's story, but the police were still unconvinced that either of them were telling the truth.
cn: Ray乐于证实Gary的故事，但警察仍然不相信他们其中一个说的是事实。

en: The saying goes: to turn a new leaf is priceless. The saying also goes: a dog can't change their habits of eating shit!
cn: 俗话说：浪子回头金不换；可俗话又说：狗改不了吃屎！

en: Despite me wanting to go to this place for a long time, I never had the courage to actualize my dream.
cn: 尽管我已经想去这个地方好久了，但从来没勇气实现自己的愿望。

en: Even if she wasn't sick, she couldn't complete her doctoral thesis by the deadline because the thesis problem contains a vast amount of detail.
cn: 即使她没生病，到了规定的日期她也完成不了她的博士论文， 因为论文题目涉及的内容太广泛。

en: Nietzsche believes philosophers should stop riding their high horse and focus more on people's differences in values, instead of abstract systems.
cn: 尼采认为，哲学家应该少一点自命不凡，多关注人的价值问题，而不是抽象的体系。

en: We always hear people asking when they'll meet someone who'll help turn their life around, but why not ask instead who isn't that someone?
cn: 总是听到有人说何时会碰到贵人，也许我们应该问，谁不是我们的贵人？

en: The place you moved to is in such a good spot. Nowadays, everyone's looking for a good location and architecture for their house.
cn: 你搬的地方真是好地段，现在大家是看上地段和房型。

en: Grandma Ling died with unfinished business. It is said that to this day no one has dared to live in that house.
cn: 玲奶奶死的不瞑目。流传说那栋房子至今未人敢入住。

en: Do you know how much love it takes for a woman to be undressed by a man, becoming nude in front of him?
cn: 你可知道,当女人被男人脱去自己的衣服,一丝不挂的在他面前,需要多少的爱?

en: It's better to speak less than to speak too much, and it's better to speak well than to speak too little.
cn: 话多不如话少，话少不如话好。

en: This person only thinks about themselves and doesn’t consider others. If you ask for their help, you’re bound to run into trouble.
cn: 这个人只顾自己，不顾别人，你要他帮忙，准得碰钉子。

en: The two boys, aged respectively fourteen and sixteen, were dressed in the army uniform, and wore gold-lace sergeant's chevrons upon their sleeves.
cn: 这两个男孩，一个14岁、一个16岁，都穿着军队制服，衣袖上佩戴着镶金色蕾丝边的中士袖章。

en: We need at least one policymaker on the committee to provide the perspective of someone who can help make decisions about the research.
cn: 我们需要至少一个关于委员会的政策制定者，提供有助于做出关于该研究的决策者观点。

en: The truth is the truth, even if you defy it and intentionally cover it up, it is still no different from daydreaming.
cn: 真理就是真理， 就算反其道而行故意掩盖它，这样的企图和白日做梦一样，不过是妄想而已。

en: We still have more than halfway to go to get to the top of the mountain. Are you really already exhausted?
cn: 我们要走到山上，还没走到一半的路，你真的已经那么累了吗？

en: Do you remember the time you and I went to the zoo together when you and I were in elementary school?
cn: 你还记得我们还在小学时你和我一起去动物园那次吗？

en: Misogynists really are quite dangerous. The more I think about this, the more I'm able to understand the reasoning behind feminism.
cn: 厌女的人真的挺危险的。我越想这个问题，我就越觉得女权主义有道理。

en: He turned to his orange juice sullenly, sneering that every little additive would sign him up for experiments he wanted no part in.
cn: 他闷闷不乐地转向了他的橙汁，埋怨着自己不情愿地成了里头每一点添加剂的实验品。

en: Nicolas means that romanization of the Cyrillic alphabet is as beautiful as the sun, which burns your eyes when you look at it.
cn: 尼古拉斯的用意是罗马化西里尔字母就犹如太阳般美丽，若是直视会灼烧人的眼睛。

en: Every man's work, whether it be literature or music or a picture or architecture or anything else, is always a portrait of himself.
cn: 所有人的作品，不管是文学、音乐、画作、建筑或者任何载体的，都是他自己的肖像。

en: Every vertex of a 3D model has a huge amount of data associated with it, influencing the behavior of colors, textures, and lighting.
cn: 每个3D模型的顶点都有大量数据与之相关，并影响颜色，材质和光照的行为。

en: My university is celebrating its centennial this year, so you can see banners with its colors, logo, and mascot all over the place.
cn: 我的大学今年正在庆祝建校一百周年，因此你到处都可以看到带有它颜色，标志和吉祥物的横幅。

en: I am Du Yu, a student at the Faculty of Computer Science and Technology, Qilu University of Technology (Shandong Academy of Sciences).
cn: 我是杜宇，是一名来自齐鲁工业大学（山东省科学院）计算机科学与技术学部的学生。

en: Under the vast heaven, no land is not the king's land; at the edges of the land, no one is not the king's subject.
cn: 溥天之下，莫非王土；率土之滨，莫非王臣。

en: No matter how fierce the winds blow or the waves crash, it feels as effortless as strolling leisurely in a quiet courtyard.
cn: 不管风吹浪打，胜似闲庭信步。

en: One of his brothers is the wind, the other is the rain. One of his sisters is the sunshine, the other is the dawn.
cn: 祂的兄弟之一是风，另一个是雨。祂的姊妹之一是阳光，另一个是拂晓。

en: The service is also part of a comprehensive subscription plan, allowing users to choose the pricing and features that best fit individual and family needs.
cn: 此服务亦包含于综合订阅方案中，使用者可依个人或家庭方案选择适合的价格与内容。

en: Intersex children are the only children receiving gender reassignment surgery, and the right supports it in their case, unlike the left.
cn: 阴阳人儿童是唯一接受变性手术的儿童。与左派不同，右派支持他们接受手术。

en: In a crowd of a thousand people, one will be intersex. If you live in a city, you pass by intersex people regularly.
cn: 一千人之中就有一位阴阳人。你如果居住在城市，就经常会遇到阴阳人。

en: This braised pork is still too watery. Cook it for another ten minutes to thicken the sauce, so the flavor sticks to the meat.
cn: 这锅卤肉还太稀，再煮十分钟收汁一下，味道才会巴在肉上。

en: Slice the kale, and add it to a pan, with olive oil, garlic, salt and pepper, and wait until it is soft and tasty.
cn: 将羽衣甘蓝切片，放入锅中，加入橄榄油、大蒜、盐和胡椒，煮至软嫩可口。

en: The Yalu River is located on the China–North Korea border and is an important boundary river between Liaoning Province in China and North Korea.
cn: 鸭绿江位于中朝边界，是中国辽宁省与北韩之间的重要界河。

en: She weaves her baskets in the same style as her ancestors who lived in the desert and harvested fruit and vegetables.
cn: 她编织的篮子的样式，与她生活在沙漠中收获水果和蔬​​菜的祖先相同。

en: The campers made their own bird feeders with pinecones, peanut butter, and seeds. They hung them from trees with fishing line.
cn: 露营者们用松果、花生酱和种子自制了喂鸟器，并用钓鱼线将它们挂在树上。

en: One of many botanical debates regards the question of the pecan — To me, it's a fruit, and not a nut.
cn: 植物学界众多争论之一是关于山核桃的问题——在我看来，它是水果，而不是坚果。

en: She studies at a university in Hsinchu and has to ride through the Hsinchu Science Park to get to class every day.
cn: 她在新竹念大学，每天都要骑车穿过竹科上课。

en: He plans to take a short trip to Hsinchu this weekend and visit the Chenghuang Temple Night Market along the way.
cn: 他计划周末去新竹小旅行，顺便逛城隍庙夜市。

en: When traveling to Hsinchu, you must not miss the beautiful campuses of National Tsing Hua University and National Chiao Tung University.
cn: 去新竹旅游，不可错过清大、交大校园的美景。

en: The knife was so blunt that I could not cut the meat with it and I resorted to my pocket knife.
cn: 那把刀太钝了，根本切不动肉，我只好拿出我的小刀。

en: I'd made up my mind to stop snacking, but against my better judgment, I keep giving in to temptation and eating ice cream.
cn: 我下定决心要戒掉零食，但违背了自己的意愿，我还是不断屈服于诱惑，吃冰淇淋。

en: Truth is like a disco ball, and only one of the tiny little mirrors it is made up of is actually yours.
cn: 真相就像一颗迪斯可球，组成球面的无数小镜子中，只有一面是真正属于你的。

en: Cover the pan and cook until tender, then remove the cover and continue the cooking until the onions are a light brown.
cn: 盖上锅盖煮至洋葱变软，然后揭开锅盖继续煮至洋葱呈现浅棕色。

en: Tuesday marked the final day of the Diamond Jubilee celebrations, marking the 60th anniversary of Queen Elizabeth II's accession to the throne.
cn: 星期二是女王登基钻石庆典的最后一天，标志着伊莉莎白二世女王登基 60 周年。

en: Languages in the Hmong-Mien language family, also referred to as the Miao-Yao language family, are spoken across Southeast Asia and mountainous areas of southern China.
cn: 苗瑶语系的语言分布于东南亚和中国南方山区。

en: Gorelick said that the outcomes of his work in Jordan may be used to evaluate water scarcity in other Middle Eastern countries, such as Syria.
cn: 戈雷利克表示，他在约旦的研究成果可用于评估叙利亚等其他中东国家的水资源短缺。

en: Why do you go online, surf, chat, and use QQ every time you have free time, wasting an entire night on it?
cn: 你怎幺一有空就上网，冲浪灌水打QQ，一个夜晚就扔给它了？

en: The colour of some hydrangeas is determined by the pH value of the soil: the more acidic it is, the bluer the flowers are.
cn: 某些绣球花的颜色取决于土壤的酸碱值：土壤酸性越强，花朵颜色越蓝。

en: How high is the probability that two out of twenty people have the same birthday? It can be assumed that a year has 365 days.
cn: 假设一年有 365 天，20 个人中有 2 个人同一天生日的机率是多少？

en: The scenery of Basutoland is rugged and grand, with a beauty quite its own, and unlike any other part of South Africa I have seen.
cn: 巴苏陀兰的景色崎岖壮丽，别具一格，与我见过的南非其他地方都截然不同。

en: Since my boyfriend is more of an indoors person, I didn't go to the beach, nor to the mountains this summer.
cn: 由于男友不喜欢出门，所以今年夏天我既没去海边，也没去山区。

en: Have you ever wondered how fish survive in cold winter weather, or where they go when lakes and ponds freeze over?
cn: 你有没有想过，鱼类是如何在寒冷的冬季生存的，或者当湖泊和池塘结冰时牠们会去哪里？

en: Then let me to the valley go, This pretty flower to see; That I may also learn to grow In sweet humility.
cn: 然后让我去山谷，看看这朵美丽的花；这样我也可以在甜蜜的谦卑中，学会成长。

en: They were seated side by side under an oak, and, having once tasted of the pleasure of kissing, were unable to cease their endearments.
cn: 他们并排坐在橡树下，尝到了接吻的滋味后，便无法停止彼此的爱意。

en: The cedar count today is really high, so I might have to call work and tell them I'm too sick to go in.
cn: 今天的雪松数量非常高，所以我可能得打电话给单位，说我病得太厉害不能去上班了。

en: Japan’s government announced Monday that the world’s third-largest economy grew at an annual pace of 21% in the third quarter spanning from July to September.
cn: 日本政府周一宣布，全球第三大经济体在 7 月至 9 月的第三季以年率计算成长了 21%。

en: Known as the water towers of Asia, the Himalayas feed 10 major rivers such as the Yangtze, the Ganges and the Indus.
cn: 喜马拉雅山脉被称为亚洲的水塔，孕育了长江、恒河、印度河等 10 条主要河流。

en: America is a nation that can be defined in a single word. I was in the foothills of the Himalayas with Xi Jinping.
cn: 美国是一个可以用一个字来概括的国家。我曾与习近平主席一起在喜马拉雅山麓。

en: Tourists struggle for breath as they climb for two hours to reach the top of a mountain in the Peruvian Andes.
cn: 游客攀登秘鲁安地斯山脉的一座山峰，历经两个小时才到达山顶，他们气喘吁吁。

en: I will note down the recommended bibliography on the list and look for them next time I come to the library.
cn: 我会将推荐的书目记在清单上，下次来图书馆时看。

en: The craft has two massive solar panels, 7 meters each, that will provide the power it needs to travel 850 million kilometers from the sun.
cn: 该飞行器有两个直径 7 公尺巨大太阳能电池板，为其提供从太阳出发飞行 8.5 亿公里所需的动力。

en: After finishing his meal at the restaurant in a great mood, he left a generous tip, much to the waiter's delighted surprise.
cn: 他在餐厅吃完饭后，心情大好，便留下了一笔大大的小费，让服务生惊喜不已。

en: In Olympic competitions, the gold medal represents first place, the silver medal represents second place, and the bronze medal represents third place.
cn: 在奥运比赛中，金牌代表第一名，银牌代表第二名，铜牌代表第三名。

en: Rapid tests are convenient, but there is still a possibility of false positives or false negatives, and they cannot fully replace PCR testing.
cn: 快筛虽然方便，但仍有伪阳性或伪阴性的可能，不能完全取代 PCR 检测。

en: If you ever saw the slums in the poor countries, you would feel that you're really not so poor. Those slum dwellers are human, too.
cn: 你如果看过贫穷国家的贫民窟，就会觉得自己其实没那么穷。那些贫民窟的居民也是人。

en: A move-in date of July 1st would work for us, but we could also move in as soon as early June.
cn: 七月一日入住对我们来说可以，但我们最早六月初也能入住。

en: Ever since the CEO was caught saying racial slurs on a hot mic, the whole PR team has been doing damage control.
cn: 自从执行长无意被麦克风录到说出种族歧视言论，整个公关团队就一直在忙着善后。

en: Today our numbers are few, but with the right political strategy, in a couple years we may number in the tens of thousands.
cn: 我们目前人数不多，但只要政治策略得当，几年后或许能达到数万人。

en: He said "sorry ma'am, the bus is full" and I'm like "no it's not, I can see two empty seats right there".
cn: 他说：「女士，抱歉，车已经满了。」然后我就说：「才没有，我明明就看到那边有两个空位。」

en: I like to use wireless headphones so that I can clean while listening to a podcast. Otherwise, the wires get in my way.
cn: 我喜欢用无线耳机，这样我就可以一边听 podcast 一边打扫，不然线会碍事。

en: I usually stand with one hand on the overhead bar, but if my legs get too tired, sometimes I sit down on the train.
cn: 搭车的时候，我通常一只手抓着头顶的扶杆站着，但如果腿太酸了，有时候也会坐下来。

en: I'm not sure if you remember me, but I'm an alumnus who took a couple of your classes during my senior year.
cn: 不知道您是否还记得我，我是曾在大四修过您几门课的校友。

en: The integral and the antiderivative are defined in two different ways, and the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus states the relationship between them.
cn: 积分与反导函数是以两种不同的方式定义的，而微积分基本定理阐述了两者之间的关系。

en: Brahe had a brother who grew up to serve in the government. He also had a sister that became a scientist.
cn: 布拉赫有一个兄弟，长大后在政府任职。他还有一个姊妹，后来成为了科学家。

en: Sorry, but I'm looking for my sister. Is she here? I haven't seen her since we arrived a couple of hours ago.
cn: 不好意思，我在找我姊姊。她在这里吗？自从我们几个小时前到这里之后，我就没见过她了。

en: I like to add a couple pods of star anise when cooking rice. It has a slightly sweet flavor and a licorice-like fragrance.
cn: 我喜欢煮饭时加几粒八角。它带有淡淡的甜味和类似甘草的香气。

en: The stranger who sails for the first time up the Firth of Forth must be struck with the numerous villages that stud its picturesque shores.
cn: 众多村庄点缀着福斯湾的岸边，优美如画。初次于此航行的陌生人，必定会留下深刻印象。

en: At times, I felt like I was living in a fog, unable to see the light at the end of the tunnel.
cn: 有时候，我感觉自己身处迷雾之中，不知该去往何方。

en: The Easter Egg Roll is an annual event that is held on the lawn of the White House each Easter Monday.
cn: 复活节滚彩蛋活动每年复活节周一都会在白宫的草地上举行。

en: Multinationals and extremely rich people manage, sometimes legally, sometimes illegally, to pay little to no taxes by using services offered in fiscal paradises.
cn: 跨国公司和极富有的人透过利用避税天堂所提供的服务，时而合法、时而非法地少缴甚至不缴税。

en: My husband and I are going on Sunday to see the ballet, Carmen, performed by the National Ballet Company at the Four Seasons Centre.
cn: 我和丈夫周日要去四季演艺中心，去看国家芭蕾舞团表演的芭蕾舞剧《卡门》。

en: I counted. A pine tree like this has over three hundred annual rings, yet it took only 15 minutes to cut it down.
cn: 我数了一下，这样一棵松树有三百多圈年轮。而砍倒它只需要15分钟。

en: Today, people all over the world are moving out of small villages in the country to go and live in big, noisy cities.
cn: 如今，世界各地的人都选择从小农村里搬出去，搬到一个喧闹的大城市里去住。
